notes: Promo Studio and the Edit Studio. Promo Studio makes promo images for every store and social network (website cover, link previews, Instagram, Stories and Shorts, YouTube thumbnails, Chrome Web Store, itch.io, Product Hunt, Steam) from your apps' own screenshots, with five templates and a live preview that is exactly what's saved. Kits are made automatically when you add screenshots. Promo videos (16:9 and vertical) with music. The Edit Studio is a full video editor for your promos: timeline, cuts, captions, picture-in-picture, grids, zoom keyframes, transitions and sound. Also: beautiful customer emails with copy buttons.
